title.en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio and folds it into Rosalind

current_state.zh:
OpenAI 周二宣布收购旧金山初创公司 Orchestra Bio，该公司的人工智能代理用于跟踪和协调药物研发项目；其团队与平台将被并入 OpenAI 面向生物学家和化学家的 AI 模型与工具套件 Rosalind。交易金额未披露。

OpenAI 表示，目标是帮助科学家做出发现，并管理将这些发现转化为更快惠及患者的疗法所需的工作；合并后的团队将构建智能代理，把科学发现与把有希望的结果转化为药物所需的决策和后续研究连接起来。

Orchestra 的智能代理会推演诸如生产批次失败等挫折如何在药物项目中传导，并比较可能的应对方案，最终决定权仍掌握在科学家和项目负责人手中。Orchestra 成立于 2022 年秋季，种子轮融资来自 Andreessen Horowitz、Definition Capital、Insight Partners 和 8VC，累计约 2000 万美元；该公司与在纳斯达克上市、代码为 OBIO 的医疗器械公司 Orchestra BioMed 无关。
current_state.en:
OpenAI announced Tuesday that it has acquired Orchestra Bio, a San Francisco startup whose AI agents track and coordinate drug development programs, and will fold its team and platform into Rosalind, OpenAI's suite of AI models and tools for biologists and chemists. Financial terms were not disclosed.

OpenAI said the goal is to help scientists make discoveries and manage the work needed to turn them into treatments that reach patients sooner, and that the combined team will build agents connecting scientific findings with the decisions and follow-up studies required to turn a promising result into a medicine.

Orchestra's agents map how setbacks such as a failed manufacturing batch ripple through a drug program and compare possible responses, while scientists and program leaders keep the final decision. Founded in the fall of 2022, Orchestra raised a seed round from Andreessen Horowitz, Definition Capital, Insight Partners and 8VC totaling about $20 million; it is unrelated to Nasdaq-listed medical device maker Orchestra BioMed (ticker OBIO).

updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI has acquired startup Orchestra Bio and will integrate its team and technology into Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and the related Rosalind Workbench tool for planning experiments and analyzing results.
updates.background_zh: 今年 4 月，OpenAI 推出了专为生物学和药物发现构建的模型 GPT-Rosalind，仅向 Amgen、Moderna 等经过审核的美国企业客户开放，同时推出配套产品 Rosalind Workbench，将该模型与科学工具和数据连接。此前，竞争对手 Anthropic 于 4 月以约 4 亿美元收购 Coefficient Bio，各大 AI 实验室正争相掌握新药研发背后的工作流。OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在 1 月的博客文章中写道，随着 AI 进入药物发现等领域，授权、基于知识产权的协议以及按结果定价将分享所创造的价值。
updates.background_en: In April, OpenAI launched GPT-Rosalind, a model built specifically for biology and drug discovery and restricted to vetted U.S. enterprise customers such as Amgen and Moderna, alongside a companion product, Rosalind Workbench, that connects the model to scientific tools and data. The deal follows Anthropic's roughly $400 million purchase of Coefficient Bio in April, as rival AI labs compete to own the workflow behind new medicines. OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar wrote in a January blog post that licensing, IP-based agreements and outcome-based pricing will share in the value created as AI moves into drug discovery.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这笔收购没有直接的加密市场传导路径；其影响主要体现在情绪层面，强化了交易者用于 AI 概念代币的“AI 扩张”叙事，并对比特币等去中心化科学（DeSci）项目构成边际上的情绪支撑——这类项目常以中心化药企研发的替代方案自居。
updates.market_impact_en: The acquisition has no direct crypto-market transmission path; its read-through is to sentiment, reinforcing the AI-expansion narrative that traders apply to AI-themed tokens and lending a marginal tailwind to decentralized-science projects that pitch themselves as alternatives to centralized pharma R&D.
